Method of Attack: UEFI firmware infection module delivered by TrickBot malware
Analyzes UEFI firmware to check for write protection disabled
Reads, writes, and erases firmware if write protection is disabled
Can brick device, bypass OS security controls, or reinfect system after reinstall
Impacted Systems: Intel platforms including Skylake, Kaby Lake, Coffee Lake, Comet Lake
Indicators of Compromise: Use of RwDrv.sys driver from RWEverything utility
Pulse Secure Appliance 5000 (PSA-5000) and Appliance 7000 (PSA-7000) devices
